filled.description:
Whether or not this specific instance has been processed. Especially helpful when calls from the
front end require full resolution and serves as a marker for server to know entire instance has
been fully resolved.

variables.description:
{@link App.Metric#variables} values to use for evaluation. The keys should be respective {@link App.Metric.Variable#id}
for the variables to set at runtime.

{@link App.Metric#query} can potentially expose dynamic references to other {@link App.Metric} or {@link App.Meter}:
Variables with key "{@link App.Metric#APP_METER_DYNAMIC_REFERENCE meters_d}" (dynamic {@link App.Meter} references),
must have values of an array of{@link App.Metric.MeterRef}.

Variables with key "{@link App.Metric#APP_METRIC_DYNAMIC_REFERENCE metrics_d}" (dynamic {@link App.Metric} references),
must have values of an array of{@link App.Metric.Bound<App.Metric.QuerySpec>}.
`string` valued variables defined at this {@link App.Metric.QuerySpec} level will be available for evaluation to the
{@link App.Metric.Bound<App.Metric.QuerySpec} as well.

{@see App.Metric#APP_METRIC_DYNAMIC_REFERENCE}
{@see App.Metric#query}.
{@see App.Metric.QuerySpec#variables}

name.description: Name to assign this metric in {@link EvalMetricsResult}. If not specified, {@link #metric#id} is used.

return.description: The return scope of the evaluation.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the metric that can be specified if the {@link App.Metric#unit} is ambiguous.

title: Field spec for evaluating a single metric.
name: App.Metric.EvaluateSpec
